_description: PINNED shared grid + conventions for STAGE 1 cosmic-shear 3PCF comparison (our zeta-derived natural components vs fastnc). BOTH the our-side agent and the fastnc-side agent MUST evaluate on this EXACT grid and write an npz following npz_schema. This file is the single source of truth that guarantees the two independent pipelines are compared apples-to-apples.
pk_units: h-units: k [h/Mpc], P [(Mpc/h)^3] at z=0. fastnc is h-unit-native (bispectrum.py:293 chi*=h -> Mpc/h, so k=ell/chi in h/Mpc); feed this file DIRECTLY to fastnc set_pklin, no conversion. Our side converts to physical 1/Mpc internally (units='physical').
geometry: SAS isoceles family: two equal sides t1 = t2 = gamma, opening angle phi between them; third side t3 = 2*gamma*sin(phi/2). fastnc FastNaturalComponents forces t2=t1 (fastnc.py:219-222). OUR side evaluates zeta on cosine_triples = (cos t3, cos gamma, cos gamma) with t3 = 2*gamma*sin(phi/2).

primary_point.note: REPORT Gamma^0..3 here FIRST, both sides (numbers + |ratio| + sign), BEFORE any sweep. Mandatory single-point-first gate.

bihalofit_plumbing_point.note: Step-1 BiHalofit large-gamma order-of-magnitude plumbing check ONLY (loose ~20%, tree~nonlinear at large gamma). NOT the physics validation.

phi_to_zero: After the finite-phi comparison, extrapolate the phi-sweep at gamma=10' toward phi->0 (the COLLAPSED/degenerate-triangle slice = two of the three 3PCF points coincident). Do NOT evaluate fastnc exactly at phi=0; extrapolate the finite-phi curve.
projection_note: Use the CENTROID projection on BOTH sides (fastnc projection='cent', validated from native x-projection via arXiv:2309.08601; AVOID the ortho2cent round-trip which raises NotImplementedError). Our side must implement the SAME centroid spin-2 phase convention; read fastnc's decompose/projection source to match the exact Gamma^i definition and phase sign.
natural_components: Schneider-Lombardi cosmic-shear 3PCF natural components Gamma^0, Gamma^1, Gamma^2, Gamma^3 (4 complex functions), flat-sky. Match fastnc's exact definition/normalization/sign.

npz_schema.convention_note: str: the EXACT Gamma^i definition + spin-2 phase/projection convention used, with source/eqn references, so the synthesis step can verify the two sides used the same convention.
